definitions.explanation: The percentage of people who support or approve of a political leader, party, or policy. A key metric in political polling and news reporting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧{支持率|しじりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世論調査|よろんちょうさ}→世論調査：16942_yoronchousa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{支持率|しじりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧30%だった。
examples.english: In the latest public opinion poll, the approval rating was 30%.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政権|せいけん}→政権：12883_seiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支持率|しじりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急落|きゅうらく}→急落：09399_kyuuraku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{首相|しゅしょう}→首相：03217_shushou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内閣改造|ないかくかいぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{切|き}った→踏み切る：06237_fumikiru⟧。
examples.english: Because the administration's approval rating plummeted, the prime minister decided on a cabinet reshuffle.

notes:
USAGE:
A staple of Japanese political news. NHK, major newspapers, and other media regularly publish ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧{支持率|しじりつ} surveys. Also used for political parties and individual politicians.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧{支持率|しじりつ} (cabinet approval rating)
- ⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧{支持率|しじりつ} (party support rate)
- {支持率|しじりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧/⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧ (approval rating goes up/down)
- {支持率|しじりつ}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧ (approval rating survey)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不支持率|ふしじりつ}: disapproval rating — the opposite metric, often reported alongside
- ⟦{投票率|とうひょうりつ}→投票率：22200_touhyouritsu⟧: voter turnout — the percentage of eligible voters who actually voted
